title: StrengthSMPz
description: A Strength-based PvP SMP plugin with random weapons, passive effects, ultimate abilities, cooldowns, and configurable combat progression.
body:
# StrengthSMP

StrengthSMP is a PvP-focused SMP plugin where players gain strength, receive a random weapon type, and unlock powerful passive and ultimate abilities through combat.

## Features

- Strength progression system
- Random weapon assignment
- Passive weapon effects
- Ultimate weapon abilities
- Configurable cooldowns and durations
- Strength withdrawal items
- Trust system to prevent abilities from harming trusted players
- Admin commands for reloading, rerolling weapons, setting strength, and setting weapons
- Blocks vanilla Strength potions for fairer gameplay
- Supports sword, axe, trident, shield, bow, and crossbow ability types

## Commands

- `/strength` - Check your strength and weapon
- `/withdraw <amount>` - Withdraw strength into items
- `/ability` - Activate your weapon's ultimate ability
- `/trust <add|remove|list> [player]` - Manage trusted players
- `/strengthsmp` or `/ssmp` - Admin command

StrengthSMP is designed for competitive survival servers that want custom combat progression, unique weapon abilities, and a stronger PvP loop.
